olivia: FYI hit a weird SSE resume case in the onboarding sample. If network drops mid-json the client sometimes gets a duplicate tail fragment on reconnect and JSON parse fails.

tj: browser EventSource or node stream?

olivia: EventSource and node-fetch sample both affected. Short repro: start a multi-chunk JSON, drop net in middle, reconnect with Last-Event-ID, see duplicated suffix or missing bytes.

tj: sounds like resume token advanced at fragment emission. Short-term: add dedupe by tracking last-fragment hash per event id in sample app. Long-term: runtime should emit logical-boundary sentinel or only advance resume token on full message flush.

olivia: filed TKT-4510 with logs, pushing small sample-app fix + README note.
bot: CI passed: sample-app (fix/sse-dedupe)
